I do not buy chemical fertilizer for this small rented plot because the money is needed for food grain on my own land, and one bag is too much for this little place anyway. I will cut the weeds with my sickle when they grow thick, and my family will pick the fruit when it ripens — that is all the work it needs. My neighbors do not hire labor for such small plots, so I will do the same.
